package nextbestaction

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"testing"
)

func TestGetRejectsInvalidActorWithoutOwnerCall(t *testing.T) {
	r := &ownerReader{}
	_, err := (Get{Enabled: true, Actions: r}).Execute(context.Background(), "not-a-student")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
	require.Zero(t, r.calls)
}
